europe_now.title: Latvia seeks billions in EU aid for war fallout
europe_now.summary: Latvia has requested approximately 7 billion euros from the EU to mitigate economic fallout from Russia’s war. The funding aims to support national resilience and recovery efforts.

europe_now.title: French taxpayers warned after personal data stolen in major hack
europe_now.summary: French taxpayers have been alerted following a major data breach involving personal information. Officials are advising affected individuals on steps to safeguard their data.

top_stories.title: Wildfires across Europe
top_stories.summary: Wildfires have continued across several European countries, including Belgium. French officials have faced public criticism over their wildfire response.

top_stories.title: Ukraine-Russia military escalation
top_stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine have traded more deadly strikes. The incident involves reciprocal deadly military actions between the two nations.

top_stories.title: EU action against online extremist network
top_stories.summary: EU authorities have taken action against a nihilist online extremist network designated as ‘The Com’. The move relates to concerns that current security policies might be outdated.

top_stories.title: Sicilian museum art theft
top_stories.summary: A Sicilian museum was the target of an art theft with valuables estimated at around 80 million euros. The incident involves the theft of significant cultural assets.
